text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Family of Nigerian presidential claimant Moshood Abiola asks military ruler General Sani Abacha for permission to see the jailed politician because of concern over is health.
- Central bank director of research Michael Ojo says bank's new responsibility of supervising all the country's banks will help tighten its grip on monetary control.
- Security agents in northern city of Kaduna bar local rights group, Network Justice, from holding a public lecture on the human rights situation in Nigeria.
